services.title: Towing
services.body: Vehicles and equipment are secured and moved the way the load actually calls for.

reviews.author: Leslie
reviews.text: I cannot tell you how wonderful this guy is. He came to our rescue when our camper tire blew out on the side of the highway, when literally no one else would help us. I called him after attempting to get multiple other companies to come out. He was there within 10 minutes. He was smiling and upbeat which is exactly what we needed to help put us at ease. This was hands-down the best tow truck experience we have ever had.

reviews.author: Naomie Missie
reviews.text: Excellent experience! Very impressed! the driver arrived in less than 30mins , and handled my vehicle with care. Very professional, courteous, and efficient. He genuinely cared about my safety and security, which made a stressful situation much easier! I will definitely use this company again and recommend them to others. Not to mention that the prices are the best ! I called about 5 towing companies and this was last and still made it first with better pricing as well!

reviews.author: Satasha Langley
reviews.text: Got a tow, needed a receipt for my insurance claim was told to send him my email and he would send the receipt never got one. Called, said he would send it he forgot. Nothing. Husband text said he was going to send it...nothing. Now texts and calls are being ignored. Known this man for years and done business with him and hooked him up at my prior job to be treated this way. Very disappointed in the situation.

reviews.author: Shayne Griffin
reviews.text: It’s almost like Rick descended from heaven in our time of need. We had a U-Haul AND car haul trailer stuck in mud & he made quick work of the job! He also had a positive attitude throughout the process. Price was also less than 10+ places we called! 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: M SS
reviews.text: Few weeks ago, I got a flat tire on I95 in NC. Roadside assistance was called and I received a call from Anthony, Big Bully Towing that they are on the way…. They never showed up! Even thought I was confirmed thru Anthony (Big Bully) that they are getting paid from the Roadside Insurance, they still did not show up. They left my family with kids and I stranded with getting close to night fall approaching and now also dead battery and failing cell phone power charge. They wouldn’t answer my call from my phone ( but when I called from different cell ) Anthony picked up to tell me ,Big Bully truck on the way…. They never showed up! . Thank God for the NC State Police ( I am very appreciative ) and the service of the other Roadside Company that that I contacted hours later after Big Bully’s no show. It was over an hour away driving distance for the other company, but they showed up.(They picked up the additional 4+ stars from me). Shame on you Big Bully for leaving us stranded. You were few minutes away and you did not have the decency to come by to help, even though you were getting paid from my Insurance company and I even offered to pay you from my own pocket. Shame on you Big Bully and may God forgive you.

reviews.author: Mark King
reviews.text: Excellent service. Picked up the phone on a Saturday afternoon when no one else was. Showed up within 15 minutes. Pulled a Uhaul out of the front yard within minutes. Highly recommend. Thanks Anthony!

reviews.author: Versatility by Liv
reviews.text: This was the best experience ever!!!!! I was down an out and BIG BULLY CAME THROUGH. He waited patiently with us am the vehicle until we got situated . When you need a reliable and quick service make sure you get Big Bully!!!

reviews.author: Larry Branch
reviews.text: Bell Boyz Auto located in the back had worked on several of my vehicles! Respectful young guy that is very reasonably priced!

reviews.author: BOY MoM
reviews.text: He Was Literally An ANGEL sent From GOD! He Helped Us When Me And My Friends Was Stranded In A Dead Cybertruck, No One Wanted To Help Us Due To The Cybertruck & He Did!!! He Also Sat There With Us And Waited Till The Truck Was Charged & Made Sure We Was Safe!!! Thank You Again Anthony BIG Bully

reviews.author: Tina Snow
reviews.text: He helped us jump our Cybertruck & towed it to the correct charging station. He initially didn’t wanna charge us because of a delay but waited till truck was charged to leave. Literally an ANGEL the sky!

reviews.author: Kimberly Weaver
reviews.text: We called this morning because of a flat tire. The gentleman that responded was so pleasant and had a big smile even though it very early on Monday morning and slightly raining. He was professional and made sure we were all set before leaving us. Great customer service and caring person!!

reviews.author: Larry Arrington
reviews.text: They really do take pride in everything that they do and it shows! Extremely dependable. Very quick response time Courteous & Professional. Put me at ease as they transported my car to the body shop for repairs. Truly understand what customer service means during a stressful situation. Strongly recommend Big Bully Towing hands down!

reviews.author: Ann Langle
reviews.text: I am from out of state and had a bad blow out on I95N. I called my roadside assistance thru insurance and long story short 2 hrs and 5 people later they said they still couldn't find anyone available. I called Big Bully Town in after a quick internet search and they were 15 min or less from my location. They answered quickly and the voice on the other end was personable and quick to tell me he would check with Josh and call me right back! I was overjoyed to hear back from them within 5 minutes offering to come help. In that time, a police officer stopped and helped me in my distress so I called Josh and crew bavk and told them "thank you for being so willing and professional." I highly recommend this place as they were ready to help me in my time of need!

reviews.author: CMAC
reviews.text: We got a flat tire Thanksgiving weekend. Called several companies and it was going to be over and hour. He came right out and fixed the tire immediately. Thank you so much for your quick response and excellent service. I would definitely recommend for all your towing/service needs

reviews.author: chimere pryor
reviews.text: Trey helped us tremendously when our car broke down on the side of a highway! He helped us in more ways than we possibly could have ever imagined and I’m absolutely grateful

reviews.author: Angel battle
reviews.text: Mr. Anthony was very professional and courtesy. He came when called at 2 in the morning and got the car fast and to the destination safely. My go too towing company.

reviews.author: Nik Kei
reviews.text: Locked my keys in trunk and gave Anthony a call. He answered and was at my location quickly. Anthony got my keys out and had me on my way. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Melissa Marquette
reviews.text: Thank you Big Bully Town for taking care of my dodge promaster. Anthony B. Showed up and had the Promaster loaded quickly. He was very nice. I recommend Big Bully Towing.

reviews.author: Larry Parker
reviews.text: I got stuck in mud with not much time to spare on my way to the airport. Their response time was very quick. Thanks to them, I made my flight and didn't have to buy a new ticket.

reviews.author: Philip Broomell
reviews.text: Outstanding service. Quick and knowledgeable. Go with the professionals. They quickly responded and took my Truck to the dealer within minutes of my call.

reviews.author: Nicole Revis
reviews.text: Every time I have called Mr. Anthony has came quickly. He is very professional and always have a caring attitude.

reviews.author: Brandon Turner
reviews.text: Thanks so much for getting keys out of car last night. I gave the wrong address and you showed up unfazed and smiling. True professional. 5 stars all day.

reviews.author: Tamara Faizi
reviews.text: The first time i use this service, the services were awesome. They came right away and got the job done. The second time it was like a no call no show.

reviews.author: Ryan Grogan
reviews.text: Left me stranded on the side of the road, stopped answering the phone and never returned voice mails. Called another company who came out right away. Avoid.

reviews.author: Carrie Davis
reviews.text: I loved the service and will be referring all of my friends to this business. Thank you BIG BULLY TOWING so very MUCH!

reviews.author: Sherita McDaniel
reviews.text: Life saver in a real cold situation! Fast to respond and very professional! My family and I really appreciate all your help.

reviews.author: Mrr Nobody
reviews.text: Too good of a guy Kind hearted and committed to helping and service where others I called were only about the money. Thanks

reviews.author: Dennis Marton
reviews.text: We were on the side of the road for several hours waiting for AAA to show which they never did! We called Big Bully he was there to help with in a half hour after we called! I would recommend this company highly!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: This man was outstanding! We waited on the side of the highway for 3 hours, he showed up and had us gone in 15 minutes. A genuine dude you don't often meet. If you are broke down in this area CALL THS MAN!!!
